facts.activity_file: making up, decanting and dosing reagents

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: chemical release during routine operation on TK-8311

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 17 October 2004 an incident occurred on TK-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
